notes: 105 round-robin games from the LiveScoresheet grids and 22 double-elimination games. RR player stats from Individual PPG: points recovered from PPG x Qs played (overall per 20 TUH, subjects per 4 TUH; overall equals the subject sum for every player) plus tossups heard; no correct/neg counts and no energy column. Players matched to teams through the Team List rosters (two ambiguous JasonY rows and one unrostered player skipped).
